description.value: Manpuku Bento is an authentic Japanese bento shop in Vancouver's Chinatown, founded in 2019 and built around scratch-made staples like house-roasted chicken stock and premium wild Sockeye salmon. The shop focuses on generous, affordable bento boxes designed for takeout, with online ordering available for pickup or delivery. A sister location, Manpuku Sushi, operates in Squamish.

address.value: 288 E Pender St, Vancouver, BC V6A 1T7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active Japanese bento takeout restaurant at 288 E Pender St, Vancouver, open since 2019. The site explicitly offers online ordering for pickup/delivery, and the Vancouver menu prominently marks many items with a vegetarian icon (🥕), confirming vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number (604) 687-0849 is sourced from the website only; OSM record contains no phone tag, so cross-validation against OSM was not possible.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible takeout restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown with a live website and online ordering. Useful to touring cyclists as a food stop with packaged bento and vegetarian options.
